name: MediaFetch Adobe CEP
releaseNotes: Official MediaFetch v1.0.0 release. Apple AMOLED theme, 3-tier icon themes, Search Studio, and multi-threaded engine.

Crystal-Clear Text Legibility: Upgraded text contrast across all 4 sections with bright crisp white headings (#FFFFFF) and high-visibility light silver secondary text (#CBD5E1), eliminating all washed-out grey tones.

Minimal & Abstract Obsidian Glass: Refined card styling to dark, deep frosted glass (rgba(13, 17, 26, 0.88)) with subtle, minimal moving chromatic sheen (0.12 opacity) and delicate 1px specular shimmer rims.
Calibrated Background Atmosphere: Toned down ambient fluid mesh to a gentle, elegant background drift, preventing screen wash-out and preserving pitch-black contrast.
Uncluttered Native Header: Cleaned up the top app bar, removing bulky container borders so the logo and header controls float seamlessly.
Refined Ambient Footer Aura: Reduced bottom ambient aura height and opacity for a subtle, elegant glow behind the floating dock.
